cand.title: GemGenève 2027
cand.excerpt: International jewellery/gem professionals; verify buyer/exhibitor housing.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Mathieu Dekeukelaire, Director: official biography covers strategic and operational challenges and event programming. Nadège Totah, Board of Directors: official biography calls her the “go-to person for GemGenève exhibitors”. These are relevant proposal-routing contacts, not verified hotel-contract buyers. Both can be approached through the published general address info@gemgeneve.com; no personal email or hotel procurement authority established.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed eleventh edition: 11–14 May 2027, Palexpo Hall 2, Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Both the organiser’s practical page and Palexpo publish activity dates, not merely an article timestamp. Within the requested horizon. No 2028 edition dates established.
findings.hotelProductFit: INFERENCE using supplied hotel constraints and published location/access: conditional secondary lodging or small offsite-meeting prospect, not a qualified local catering lead or replacement exhibition venue. The 237-room Founex hotel and approximately 250-theatre largest room cannot host the full fair; a selective exhibitor/staff subgroup and associated briefing/F&B is more plausible. Test a 20–120-room commercial-band proposal only after demand is confirmed; this is a sales scenario, not published demand. Airport-corridor access helps, but Founex is not walkable Palexpo accommodation. The hotel advertises an airport shuttle in morning/evening only, with no midday service and no advance booking; no GemGenève shuttle is evidenced. Resort positioning is not a demonstrated event requirement; practical access matters more.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue commitment is Palexpo – Halle 2, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Geneva, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, not downtown Geneva, and not Lausanne. It is an exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. Public venue confirmation does not disclose contract terms or hotel commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented editions remain at Palexpo in the Geneva destination, with hall changes rather than destination rotation. Historical timeline below includes spring and autumn editions in 2022 and 2023; do not assume an uninterrupted annual-only cycle. Hall 1 in 2024–2025 changes to Hall 2 in 2026–2027. Historical offsite hospitality: Marriott Hotel, Geneva hosted the 9 May 2024 Designer Soirée with advertised Palexpo shuttles; the tenth-edition exhibitors’ evening took place at Geneva’s Musée d’Art et d’Histoire. Neither establishes a 2027 commitment.
findings.accommodationSourcing: UNKNOWN for 2027. Official practical information states “Palexpo Halle 2 Route Francois-Peyrot 30 1218 – Le Grand-Saconnex GE Switzerland” and gives admission/access information; the contact page routes visitors and exhibitors to “info@gemgeneve.com”. No edition-specific official housing bureau, host hotel, accommodation hotel list, rates, published room block or open hotel RFP was established. Therefore there are no verified 2027 listed housing hotels to name. Marriott Hotel, Geneva is a verified 2024 soirée venue, NOT a verified accommodation block. Third-party hotel suggestions and UN preferential-rate lists are not organiser commitments. Silence does not establish open sourcing.
findings.organizationStructure: Palexpo identifies GEMEXPO SA as organiser. The organiser’s data policy identifies the Swiss company GEMEXPO SA, headquartered at 9–11 Place de la Fusterie, 1204 Geneva, UID CHE-139.241.791. The official team identifies founders Thomas Faerber and Ronny Totah and Director Mathieu Dekeukelaire. Classification: commercially organised jewellery/gem trade fair, open also to private buyers; not evidenced as an association congress. No appointed housing agency, PCO or DMC established. Palexpo is the venue, not evidence of a lodging buyer.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No verified 2027 incumbent accommodation hotels, contracted bureau, sold-out condition or overflow demand found. Published historical hospitality incumbents are Marriott Hotel, Geneva (2024 Designer Soirée) and Musée d’Art et d’Histoire, Geneva (2026 exhibitors’ evening), not evidence of current room blocks. INFERENCE: Palexpo’s airport/rail proximity and existing Geneva hospitality relationships make a Founex detour a competitive disadvantage unless rate, logistics and subgroup needs justify it. Do not claim displaced demand or automatic Palexpo overflow.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Mathieu Dekeukelaire via info@gemgeneve.com, with Nadège Totah as exhibitor-facing routing contact. Ask who handles 2027 exhibitor/staff accommodation and offsite hospitality, whether a bureau or existing hotel agreements apply, and whether any subset needs an airport-corridor alternative. Offer a short site visit and conditional subgroup lodging/briefing/F&B concept within the supplied 20–120-room band, not an unsolicited whole-house block. Validate dedicated Palexpo transfer timings/capacity and security expectations before pricing. If no 2027 opening exists, seek the next review date and permission to develop exhibitor relationships. Retain as conditional secondary lodging/relationship development; do not qualify the original local_catering_day_meetings segment without a specific brief.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 exhibition venue is confirmed, but hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed—not demonstrably open and not demonstrably committed elsewhere. Contact access exists through the organiser’s general enquiry channel. No current hotel RFP, referral programme, room allocation or offsite catering tender established. General admission to the fair does not imply procurement access.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: INFERENCE: repeated Palexpo editions support relationship development for exhibitor/staff lodging and small briefings, not relocation of the fair to YOTEL. Historical hotel-hosted hospitality with a Palexpo shuttle demonstrates a possible offsite format, not YOTEL demand. If 2027 sourcing is closed, request the next hotel-review window and introduction to the responsible person; do not attach invented 2028 dates or claim a future RFP.
